source.author: ov
source.text: Quae pater ut summa vidit Saturnius arce, ingemit et, facto nondum vulgata recenti, foeda Lycaoniae referens convivia mensae, ingentes animo et dignas Iove concipit iras, conciliumque vocat: tenuit mora nulla vocatos.
source.text_original: Quae pater ut summa vidit Saturnius arce, / ingemit et, facto nondum vulgata recenti, / foeda Lycaoniae referens convivia mensae, / ingentes animo et dignas Iove concipit iras, / conciliumque vocat: tenuit mora nulla vocatos.
source.text_english: When the Saturnian father saw these things from the highest citadel, he groaned, and, with the recent deed not yet made known abroad, recalling the foul feast at Lycaon’s table, he conceived in his mind great anger, worthy of Jove, and called a council; no delay held back those summoned.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: nostris modo concitus ausis aequoreos vocat ecce deos Neptunus et ingens concilium.
reuse.text_original: nostris modo concitus ausis / aequoreos vocat ecce deos Neptunus et ingens / concilium.
reuse.text_english: Just now, stirred by our daring, behold Neptune calls the sea gods and the great council.
